text:
jen: heads-up — since the audit-egress policy rollout at 02:10 we’re seeing new GPU nodes fail to complete KMS decrypt on boot in eu-west1. allocator success down ~15%.
sanjay: reproducing: keystore-proxy POST /decrypt -> 403 audit-scope. Keystore service says request came from subnet without keystore-exception tag.
maria: that tag was part of the retention/audit PR. looks like tag propagation failed for two eu-west1 zones during the deployment window.
jen: can we do a minimal rollback for gpu-subnet in eu-west1 to restore boot path?
kevin: two options: 1) temporary allowlist for keystore endpoints (quick) 2) rollback subnet deny rule for gpu-subnet (safer perf-wise). Allowlist will route through region NAT/privatelink and add egress costs.
sanjay: cost est: allowlist ~= +$1.2k/day if sustained; rollback has near-zero immediate cost but is config churn.
maria: suggest controlled rollback: eu-west1-a first, 15m watch, then 1/3 canary in b. keep blast radius small.
jen: agreed. ops-bot, create incident stub and notify on-call neteng.
ops-bot: incident INF-7234 created by jen at 09:35 UTC. pinging #neteng and #keystore.
kevin: CLI to remove rule (placeholder): ```gcloud compute firewall-rules update deny-egress-audit --target-tags=gpu-subnet-eu --region=eu-west1 --quiet --remove-allowlist=keystore```. will run via infra console.
maria: also patch k8s allocator to prefer warmed nodes to reduce pressure during rollout: ```kubectl -n infra patch deploy allocator --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"affinity":{"nodeAffinity": {}}}}}}'``` (small affinity tweak).
jen: rolling rollback for eu-west1-a now. will post when done.
(90s) deploy-bot: rollback applied to subnet gpu-subnet-eu-west1-a by jen at 09:42 UTC.
jen: allocator success jumped 81% -> 97% within 5m. join rate normalized.
kevin: we cut the latency penalty; however keystore audit queue shows retry backlog for ~7k decrypts. that will drain over next hour; watch token issuance metrics.
sanjay: opened INF-7234 owner=neteng, assignees=keystore. action items: fix tag propagation automation, add CI gate that verifies subnet tags post-rollout, schedule chaos test for tagging next week.
maria: will draft public-facing incident note for infra & product channels with cost impact and mitigation. include steps to avoid noisy ops-bot alerts in future.
jen: thanks. closing after postmortem and tagging fix shipped. :white_check_mark:
